author: slava77
body:
Incremental (technical) update after #51571 ; a contribution on the topic of #51245 Modifications: - use isPartOf in CountTripletLSConnectionsT to be consistent with CreateQuadrupletsT; - add earlier skips in `Create*` kernels using related `connected*Max` counters already available from the pre-allocation computation step No change in the output objects is expected. Timing (single stream) in a standalone LST setup: comparing in 1700pre2 with #51571 as a reference | Sample | Module | CPU Time (Before After) | GPU (L4) Time (Before After) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **2 TeV "very slow"**
*(1 slowest event takes most time)* | `all` | 194.4 102.0 s/ev | 116 49.7 s/ev | | | `CreateQuadrupletsT` | 61.5 3.2 s/ev | 49.5 2.77 s/ev | | | `CreateQuintupletsT` | 43.8 17.3 s/ev | 15.8 6.8 s/ev | | | `createTriplets` | ~unchanged | ~unchanged | | | `createSegments` | ~unchanged | ~unchanged | | **ttbar PU200** | `all` | 925 907 ms/ev | 7.0 6.5 ms/ev | | | `CreateQuadrupletsT` | 4.7 3.3 ms/ev | 0.39 0.16 ms/ev | | | `CreateQuintupletsT` | 26 25 ms/ev | 0.69 0.50 ms/ev | | | `createTriplets` | ~unchanged | ~unchanged | | | `createSegments` | ~unchanged | ~unchanged | [Aug 14] [from a test on a fully loaded node](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/51245#issuecomment-5293116838) with a larger sample of 2 TeV events done by @Parsifal-2045 : the full HLT throughput improves by about 1.7 for GPU backend and 1.5 for the CPU backend. (code diffs are smaller ignoring whitespace)
title: LST: add earlier skips to speedup Create* kernels using connected*Max counters
